entities.summary: José Eduardo do Prado Kelly was a Brazilian jurist, lawyer, poet, journalist and politician. He was minister of the Supreme Federal Court, president of the Order of Attorneys of Brazil (OAB), minister of Justice and Interior Affairs, federal deputy for Rio de Janeiro and president of the National Democratic Union (UDN).
